method: Zero-cost deterministic re-derivation (scripts/semantic-accountability-shared-cap-trace.ts, output 06-shared-cap-root-cause-trace.json): the same real source text, the same real structure/definition/reference/index/package-graph/context-retrieval pipeline, run twice - once EXACTLY as Mission 4's scripts ran it (structuralNodeIds empty) and once with the real physical nodeId - plus a read of the preserved Mission 4 composition output. No model call.

layerByLayer.evidence: Shared-cap language ('together with the aggregate amount of ... shall not at any time exceed an amount equal to 15% of Applicable EBITDA') is physically present in the debt-dsgr window (2 sentences) and the investments-dsgr window (1 sentence). Each proviso names the other two sections explicitly.

Mission 4's regions were located by source-first char offset and wrapped in an ad-hoc DiscoveredCandidate; the real discovery pipeline (which populates structuralNodeIds) was not run. The ad-hoc candidate left structuralNodeIds empty (BF-1) and, for the investments region, anchored to the preceding clause 6.03(g) via a closed-interval bug (BF-6).

As run: sufficiencyState INCOMPLETE, 0 items, for BOTH regions ('Cannot retrieve context for a candidate with no anchoring structural node'). With the real nodeId: 48/47 items but ZERO CROSS_REFERENCE items - the bundle is filled by 17-18 CHILD_RULE items and 25-27 DEFINITION_DEPENDENCY items and stops on maxTextBudgetChars/maxDefinitionDepth before reference expansion delivers §6.04(b) (whose reference from §6.01(b)(i)/(c)(i) DOES resolve uniquely in detectStructuralReferences). Bare 'Section 6.04'/'SECTION 6.01' references are AMBIGUOUS_RELATIVE_REFERENCE (HIGH) because the table-of-contents entry is indexed as a second, degenerate SECTION occurrence sharing the label; 'Section 6.01(b)(iii)'/'(c)(iii)' are unresolved because an inline roman-numeral proviso is not a node.

layerByLayer.status: LOST for the exact strings the model used
layerByLayer.evidence: resolveUniqueNodeByRef: 'Section 6.04(b)' NOT_FOUND (prefix not normalized on the query side - '6.04(b)' alone is UNIQUE), 'Section 6.01(b)(iii)' and '6.01(b)(iii)' NOT_FOUND (inline sub-clause), '6.04' AMBIGUOUS (TOC duplicate). getReferencedProvision therefore refused every cross-reference the model attempted; the model's own sufficiencyReasons record 'cross-reference resolution attempted for both and failed, then tool budget was exhausted'.

No source-derived inventory of the SHARED_CAP / DEPENDENCY / REFERENCE components existed, so nothing could hold composition accountable for representing the cap once, as one shared resource, referenced from three places.

investments-dsgr: the model DID emit a WireSharedCapacity for §6.04(b) (rule b4ebe266's capacityExpression is LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE -> ir-sharedcap:949e9cac) and DID emit dependsOn edges to 'Section 6.01(b)(iii)' and 'Section 6.01(c)(iii)'. debt-dsgr: the model represented §6.01(b)(iii) and §6.01(c)(iii) as TWO freestanding MULTIPLY(15%, Applicable EBITDA) rules with no SharedCapacity and no dependsOn, even though both were in the SAME batch and could have shared one WireSharedCapacity. The compiler prompt (semantic/prompt.ts) contains no instruction and no example for when to emit a SharedCapacity; sharedCapacities is present only in the submit schema.

Every cross-unit dependsOn the model emitted was dropped: resolveRuleRef only accepts a same-batch localRef or a literal 'ir-rule:' id; the drop is disclosed only as a sufficiencyReasons string. IRRuleDependency.targetRuleId is non-nullable, so an unresolved external target has no IR representation.

genericRemediationJustifiedByThisTrace.change: Validation scripts populate the real structuralNodeId (as the real discovery pipeline always does), use a half-open anchor interval, and preserve sharedCapacities/toolCallLog/rawModelOutput/inventory/reconciliation. Not a production change.

A deterministic source-context sufficiency layer (Section 12/13) builds the semantic compilation unit as operative text + EXPLICIT cross-referenced provisions (resolved with provenance, bounded), independent of Phase 2D's definition-first budget order, and records COMPLETE_LOCAL_SOURCE / DEPENDENCY_EXPANDED_SOURCE / TRUNCATED_SOURCE / STRUCTURALLY_INCOMPLETE_SOURCE / UNKNOWN_SOURCE_COMPLETENESS per unit.

Generic query normalization (strip a leading 'Section'/'§'/'Article' prefix), inline-sub-clause fallback to the nearest enclosing node WITH DISCLOSURE (resolvedViaEnclosingNode: '6.01(b)' for '6.01(b)(iii)'), and degenerate-occurrence exclusion when a label is shared by a heading-only occurrence (0 children, tiny own text) and a real body occurrence - reported as UNIQUE_AFTER_DEGENERATE_EXCLUSION with the excluded candidates listed, never a silent pick. Genuine ambiguity (two substantive occurrences) stays AMBIGUOUS -> REVIEW_REQUIRED (Section 15: never guess).

An unresolved cross-unit dependsOn is preserved as IRRule.unresolvedDependencies[] (relationshipType, targetRef, description, reason) instead of being dropped; Pass C dispositions the corresponding DEPENDENCY/REFERENCE inventory item as AMBIGUOUS (review), never REPRESENTED and never silently absent.

Generic shared-cap instruction + one synthetic example: when two or more independently operative permissions in the SAME submission draw on ONE aggregate ceiling, emit one WireSharedCapacity and reference it from each member via LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE; when the sharing partner lives in another section, emit the dependency with the section reference (kept per R-4).

SHARED_CAP, DEPENDENCY and REFERENCE are first-class inventory roles; Pass C requires each material one to be REPRESENTED (SharedCapacity/LEDGER_USAGE_REFERENCE/dependsOn/unresolvedDependencies lineage) or explicitly dispositioned.

whatWouldNotFixIt: Raising maxTextBudgetChars globally (Section 12 forbids solving this by window size), or a DSGR-specific section map (Section 19).
